legallyCompliant.question: Are invoices legally compliant?
legallyCompliant.answer: Yes. Financely captures the legal essentials (seller & buyer info, tax/VAT IDs, itemization, totals, issue & due dates, invoice number, currency, terms). You can export/share PDFs that meet common EU/US requirements.

invoiceNumbers.question: Do invoice numbers need to be government-issued?
invoiceNumbers.answer: No. Numbers must be unique, sequential in your system, and traceable. Financely auto-generates them with prefixes per organization and supports manual overrides with validation.

payments.question: What payments do you support?
payments.answer: Stripe links out of the box. You can also attach bank details and mark invoices as paid when you reconcile offline payments.

dataSecurity.question: How is my data secured?
dataSecurity.answer: We build on Google Cloud/Firebase with role-based access, audit logs, and org-level isolation.
